31 days post op! One month already!
At 55, after losing 145 pounds following gastric sleeve surgery in 2017 and maintaining that loss, I decided to address the loose skin left behind.

For those following along, I had a deep plane facelift, neck lift, endoscopic brow lift, upper and lower blepharoplasty with ptosis repair, CO₂ laser resurfacing, lip lift, earlobe repair, and buccal fat removal with fat grafting. My surgeon was Dr. Pennington in Shreveport, Louisiana, and the total cost was $115,000.

The care I have received before and after surgery has been amazing. Dr. Pennington, Hailey, and the entire team have made me feel supported and cared for throughout this process. Having a team that answers questions and helps you through recovery means so much.

Recovery is a process, and I’m still healing. Around weeks three and four, I started seeing more of myself again. There is still swelling and settling to do, so these pictures are progress, not my final results. I personally have had no pain, but recovery still requires patience and following instructions.

For those wondering what that has involved, my recovery instructions have included a very low sodium diet, no tart fruits or citrus for six weeks, sleeping elevated, using baby shampoo, and avoiding heat, including a hair dryer and hot styling tools, for six weeks. I’ve also included protein smoothies and collagen supplements, along with daily hyperbaric treatments during my early recovery. These are the instructions and choices for my recovery, and everyone should follow their own surgeon’s guidance.

And because it’s a frequent question: I did not have a nose job! That’s still the nose I got from my dad, and I like it.

I believe in supporting other women, not bashing them for their choices. We don’t all have to make the same decisions to treat each other with kindness and respect. Whether a woman chooses surgery or chooses to age naturally, she deserves that same support.

I’m sharing this journey honestly because seeing the stages of recovery matters just as much as seeing the before and after. Thank you to everyone who has followed along, prayed for me, and sent encouragement. I’m grateful for how far I’ve come and giving myself time to heal.

Living in Baton Rouge, I willingly pass by many excellent plastic surgeons to place my trust in Dr. Duplechain. His remarkable education, expertise, experience, and surgical artistry truly set him apart.

Having worked in dermatology, I understand the benefits and limitations of nonsurgical treatments, but I knew the results I was seeking required surgical expertise, and Dr. Duplechain delivered exactly what I had envisioned.

He has surrounded himself with an exceptional, carefully selected team whose professionalism is matched by genuine warmth and personal attention. From the moment you enter, the atmosphere is elegant, welcoming, and inviting, making the entire experience truly special.

I could not be more delighted with my results. I look like myself—only younger and beautifully refreshed. That, to me, is the true mark of an extraordinary surgeon.

My sincere appreciation to Dr. Duplechain and his wonderful staff for an experience that exceeded every expectation!
